blocks.zh: 表中最大的系数是接近水平和252天的官方波动。 这两个系列在两个指数上都带有单位根. 综合情绪与一个指数的接近水平之间的系数为0.347,比样本翻了两番,表明两个系列趋于一致。 我们报告这些行是因为分析产生它们并且省略它们会歪曲产出,但它们不是关系的证据.

blocks.en: What survives the stationarity filter is the magnitude of the daily move. Media and Society mood correlates with the intraday range at r = 0.257 r=0.257 on the BIST100 and r = 0.289 r=0.289 on the BIST30, and Combined at r = 0.216 r=0.216 and r = 0.239 r=0.239 , all at p < 0.001 p<0.001 . The 21-day calculated volatility, which is stationary on both indices, behaves identically at r = 0.170 r=0.170 and r = 0.214 r=0.214 for Media and Society. Days on which the index travelled through a wide intraday band were days on which Media and Society and Combined mood ran higher. Rank coefficients exceed the linear ones, so the association is monotonic rather than linear. As noted above, the range series itself is borderline stationary. It fails the test on the BIST30, so the 21-day volatility results carry the more secure version of this finding.
blocks.zh: 在静态过滤器中存活下来的是日常运动的幅度. 媒体和社会情绪与BIST100上的日内范围(r=0.257 r=0.257)和BIST30上的日内范围(r=0.289 r=0.289)相关,合并后的日内范围(r=0.216 r=0.216)和日内范围(r=0.239 r=0.239)相关,均在p < 0.001 p < 0.001 。 21天计算出的波动在两种指数上都固定不变,在r = 0.170 r = 0.170和r = 0.214 r = 0.214的媒体和社会上表现相同. 指数在一天之内通过宽广的波段的天数是媒体和社会及联合情绪上升的日子。 排名系数超过线性系数,因此关联是单数而不是线性. 如上所述,范围系列本身是边线固定的. 它在BIST30上的测试失败,因此21天的波动结果携带了这个发现的更安全版本.

blocks.en: The Economy and Finance regime is the exception and runs the other way. Its coefficients against every volatility measure are negative on both indices. Among the variables shown, the only one reaching significance is the range as a percentage of the open, at − - 0.088 on the BIST100 and − - 0.102 on the BIST30. The change in trading volume, not tabulated, is the only other Economy and Finance coefficient to reach the 0.05 level, at − - 0.114 and − - 0.092. Of the four regimes, the one composed of accounts that talk about the economy is the one whose mood moves least, and most negatively, with same-day market activity.
blocks.zh: 经济和财政制度是例外,相反。 它与每项波动计量值的系数对两个指数都是负数。 在所显示的变量中,唯一达到意义值的是开放范围的百分比,BIST100上的为0.088,BIST30上的为−0.102。 交易量的变化,没有列表,是其他唯一达到0.05水平的经济和金融系数,为−-0.114和−-0.092。 在四个政权中,由谈论经济的账户组成的一个政权的情绪变化最少,而且最消极的是同一天的市场活动。

blocks.en: 5.3 Frequency aggregation
blocks.zh: 5.3 频率汇总

blocks.en: Table 5 repeats the range and return correlations at weekly and monthly aggregation.
blocks.zh: 表5重复每周和每月汇总时的幅度和返回相关性。

blocks.en: Table 5: Public mood and market correlations across aggregation frequencies.
blocks.zh: 表5:公共情绪和市场在汇总频率之间的关联。

blocks.en: The range relationship strengthens monotonically with aggregation. On the BIST100 the Media and Society coefficient rises from 0.257 daily to 0.363 weekly, and Combined from 0.216 to 0.372. The pattern repeats with BIST30. The return relationship does not strengthen. It remains insignificant at every frequency on both indices, where the largest coefficient is 0.173 at the weekly frequency and significant only at the 0.10 level.
blocks.zh: 范围关系与聚合单调增强. 在BIST100上,媒体和社会系数从每天0.257升至每周0.363,综合系数从0.216升至0.372。 模式与BIST30重复. 回归关系没有加强. 在两个指数的每个频率上,这一系数仍然微不足道,其中最大的系数是每周频率0.173,只有0.10级。

blocks.en: The asymmetry is informative. If the daily null on returns reflected insufficient power, aggregation should improve it yet it does not. If public mood relates to market activity through attention and the gradual diffusion of narratives rather than through the pricing of new fundamental information, accumulation over longer windows should strengthen a magnitude relationship while leaving a direction relationship absent. Thus, H3 is supported for magnitude and rejected for direction.
blocks.zh: 非对称性即是信息性. 如果每天对返回的无效反应显示力量不足,汇总应该能够改善,但不会改善。 如果公共情绪是通过注意和逐渐传播叙述而不是通过定价新的基本信息与市场活动相联系的,那么在较长的窗口上的积累应当加强规模关系,同时使方向关系不复存在。 因此,H3支持量级,拒绝方向.

blocks.en: 5.4 Predictive precedence
blocks.zh: 5.4 预测优先

blocks.en: Table 6 reports the number of significant Granger tests by direction, regime, index and frequency.
blocks.zh: 表6按方向、制度、指数和频率报告了重要的格兰格测试次数。

blocks.en: Table 6: Significant Granger causality tests, full period.
blocks.zh: 表6:整个期间的重大格兰杰因果关系测试。

blocks.en: Predictive precedence is concentrated by domain. Economy and Finance accounts for 11 of the 28 daily mood-to-market tests on the BIST100 and nine of 28 on the BIST30, where chance would place roughly 1.4. These include the daily return at lags of three ( F = 5.04 F=5.04 , p = 0.0019 p=0.0019 ) and five ( F = 3.06 F=3.06 , p = 0.0098 p=0.0098 ) trading days on the BIST100, replicated on the BIST30 at three ( p = 0.0054 p=0.0054 ) and five ( p = 0.0167 p=0.0167 ), together with the closing level, the intraday change and trading volume. The result survives a change of frequency, seven of 28 weekly tests are significant on the BIST100 and four of 28 on the BIST30. No other regime produces more than two significant mood-to-market tests at either frequency on either index. H4 is supported for this direction, and H2 is supported in the specific sense that the domain determines which market property sentiment relates to.
blocks.zh: 预测优先是按领域集中的。 经济和财政在BIST100的28个日常情绪对市场测试中占据了11个,在BIST30的28个测试中占据了9个,其中的机会大约为1.4。 其中包括BIST100上的三个(F=5.04 F=5.04,p=0.0019 p=0.0019)和五个(F=3.06 F=3.06,p=0.0098 p=0.0098)交易日的每日回落时间,在BIST30上三个(P=0.0054 p=0.0054)和五个(P=0.0167 p=0.0167)上复制,加上收尾水平,日内变化和交易量. 结果在频率变化后幸存下来,每周28次测试中有7次在BIST100上显著,28次测试中有4次在BIST30上显著. 没有任何其他制度在两个指数上都进行两次以上重要的情绪对市场测试。 H4支持这个方向,H2支持的具体意义是域决定了哪个市场产权情绪相关.

blocks.en: The market-to-mood direction is thinner over the full period but contains the single strongest test in the analysis. BIST100 daily range predicts Combined mood one day ahead at F = 14.18 F=14.18 ( p = 0.0002 p=0.0002 ) with the same relationship appearing in Economy and Finance at F = 10.53 F=10.53 and in Media and Society at F = 4.67 F=4.67 . Mood also predicts the range at lag one in those three regimes, which makes the two jointly determined at that horizon rather than one leading the other. This bidirectional lag-one pattern is specific to the BIST100. On the BIST30 the range predicts Economy and Finance mood but mood does not predict the range in any regime.
blocks.zh: 整个期间的市场到模度方向更薄,但包含分析中最强的单一测试. BIST100 日范围预测 一天前的合并情绪在F = 14.18 F = 14.18 (p = 0.0002 p = 0.0002),在F = 10.53 F = 10.53 和在F = 4.67 F = 4.67 的媒体和社会 中出现同样的关系. Mood还预测了这三种制度中落后于一种的幅度,这使得这两种制度在这个地平线上共同确定,而不是一个领导另一个制度。 这种双向滞后-1模式是BIST100特有. 在BIST30上,范围预测的是经济和金融情绪,但情绪并不预测任何政权的幅度。

blocks.en: The lag structure is worth stating plainly. Market-to-mood relationships appear at one day lag onward. Mood-to-market relationships appear at three and five days lag. Under the straightforward mechanism in which an influential account posts, investors read it, and the price moves at the next open, a lag-one result is the first thing that should appear. It appears at neither frequency and is absent from the contemporaneous correlations. Impulse responses put the magnitudes in perspective. On BIST100 the largest market-to-mood response is 2.6% of a mood standard deviation on the day following a one-standard-deviation market innovation.
blocks.zh: 滞后结构值得一提。 市场对市场的关系出现一天的滞后。 对市场的关系出现3天和5天的滞后。 在一个有影响力的账户帖子的直截了当的机制下,投资者阅读了它,价格在下次开放时会变动,因此,一个落后的结果应该是第一件事。 它既不经常出现,也不出现在当时的相互关系中。 冲动的反应将规模置于正视之下。 在BIST100上,最大的市场对模拟反应是单一标准市场创新后第二天的情绪标准差的2.6%。

blocks.en: 5.5 State dependence
blocks.zh: 5.5 国家依赖性

blocks.en: Table 7 reports the sub-period Granger counts by direction.
blocks.zh: 表7按方向报告Granger的分期数。

blocks.en: Table 7: Significant daily Granger causality tests by sub-period and direction.
blocks.zh: 表7:按分期和方向分列的每日Granger重大因果关系测试。

blocks.en: In 2022, across 112 daily tests on BIST100, no market variable precedes public mood under any regime. In the election quarter of 2023 the market precedes mood in 43 of 112 tests while mood precedes the market in four. The BIST30 reproduces the reversal at 36 and 7. All four labelling regimes flip together. Politics and Government, which produces a single significant mood-to-market result in the full-period analysis, produces 14 market-to-mood results within that one quarter on the BIST100, covering the opening and closing levels, the return, the intraday change, the range and the volume at lags of two to five days.
blocks.zh: 在2022年,在BIST100的每天112次测试中,没有任何市场变量会先于任何政权下的公众情绪. 在2023年选举季度,在112项测试中的43项测试中,市场先于情绪,而在4项测试中,市场先于情绪。 BIST30在36号和7号重现了逆变. 所有四个标签制度都相互交错。 政治和政府在全周期分析中产生了一个显著的情绪对市场结果,在BIST100的四分之一内产生了14个市场对市场的结果,涉及开放和关闭水平、回报、日内变化、幅度和滞后2至5天的数量。

blocks.en: Table 8 shows the same instability in the contemporaneous coefficients.
blocks.zh: 表8显示了当时系数的不稳定性。

blocks.en: Table 8: Daily correlations by sub-period.
blocks.zh: 表8:按分期分列的每日相关性。

blocks.en: The sign reverses between 2022 and the election quarter on both indices at once. Combined mood correlates with the daily return at r = 0.177 r=0.177 ( p = 0.005 p=0.005 ) in 2022 on the BIST100 and r = 0.167 r=0.167 on the BIST30. In the election quarter the same coefficients are − - 0.281 and − - 0.247. Media and Society mood correlates with the range at 0.432 in 2022 and at essentially zero in the election quarter. All four regimes return negative correlations with trading volume in the election quarter, significant in three of four on both indices, with Combined reaching − - 0.483 and − - 0.500. All four also return a negative and significant correlation with the official 21-day volatility in that quarter on the BIST100, at − - 0.259 in Economy and Finance to − - 0.530 in Combined, which is the only period in the entire correlation analysis where all four regimes agree in sign and significance. A higher mood in the election quarter went together with a calmer and thinner market. This supports H5.
blocks.zh: 标志在2022年和选举季度之间同时在两个指数上出现逆转. 综合情绪与2022年BIST100上的日回数=0.177 r=0.177 (p=0.005 p=0.005)和BIST30上的日回数=0.167 r=0.167 有关。 选举季度的系数为−0.281和−0.247. 媒体和社会情绪与2022年的0.432和选举季度的零有关。 所有四个政权都与选举季度的交易量产生负相关关系,在两个指数中,四个指数中有三个是显著的,合并到0.483和0.500。 这四个国家还恢复了与BIST100上21天官方波动的负面和重大关联,在经济金融方面为−0.259,在合并方面为−0.530,这是整个关联分析中唯一一个所有四个政权都同意标志和意义的时期。 选举区气氛更浓厚, 这支持H5.

blocks.en: The earthquake quarter produces some of the smallest correlation coefficients of the four sub-periods. It is worth stating because the literature on sentiment and crisis would predict the opposite. Three of the twelve BIST100 cells in Table 8 reach significance on 61 observations, and each carries the opposite sign to the full-period coefficient of the same regime on the same variable.
blocks.zh: 地震季度产生四个分周期最小的关联系数. 值得指出的是,关于情绪和危机的文献会预测出相反的情况。 表8中的12个BIST100单元格中有3个在61个观测上具有意义,每个在同一个变量上都带有与同一制度全周期系数相反的标志.

blocks.en: 5.6 Regime disagreement
blocks.zh: 5.6 制度上的分歧

blocks.en: The four labelling regimes do not measure the same quantity, and the Combined regime is not an average of the other three. Its mean daily mood score of 0.016 sits against a Politics and Government mean of 0.510, a Media and Society mean of − - 0.002, an Economy and Finance mean of − - 0.093. The unweighted three-category mean is 0.138. The same ordering holds within all four sub-periods. In every one, the Combined series falls within 0.023 of the largest contributing category and never closer than 0.094 to the average of the three. Media and Society covers 297,857 of the 610,422 posts, and the pooled series reproduces it.
blocks.zh: 四个标签制度衡量的数量并不相同,合并制度并不是其他三个制度的平均数。 其每日平均情绪分数0.016,与政治和政府平均0.510,媒体和社会平均-0.002,经济和财政平均-0.093相对应。 未加权的三类平均值为0.138. 同一命令在所有四个分期内都适用。 在每个系列中,综合系列都属于最大贡献类的0.023,并且从未接近于三个类别的平均数的0.094。 媒体与社会占610,422个员额中的297,857个,集合系列复制.

blocks.en: The impact is visible throughout the tables above. Combined tracks Media and Society on the range and volatility results and departs from it elsewhere, across the thirteen daily market variables the two agree in sign on twelve. The Economy and Finance predictive results have a much weaker counterpart in the Combined series, which produces two significant daily mood-to-market tests against eleven in the regime it draws from. And the Politics and Government mood score, which is positive on all 500 trading days, has a sign that never varies. So the aggregate series cannot register the shifts in valence that its individual constituents display.
blocks.zh: 以上各表可见其影响。 媒体和社会关于范围和波动结果的联合轨道,从其他地方出发,跨越13个日常市场变量,双方在12个变量上签字。 " 经济和金融预测结果 " 综合系列的对应性要弱得多,它每天对从中得出的11个制度进行两次重大的情绪对市场的测试。 政治与政府情绪的得分, 在所有500个交易日都是积极的, 因此,集合系列无法记录其各个组成物所显示的值的变化。

blocks.en: 5.7 Account-level analysis
blocks.zh: 5.7 账户一级分析

blocks.en: Aggregating a category into one daily series assumes that its members behave alike. Table 9 reports the correlations we repeated account by account.
blocks.zh: 将一个类别合并为一个每日系列,假定其成员的行为相同。 表9按账户报告我们重复的相互关系。

blocks.en: Table 9: Accounts correlating significantly with selected market variables, by category.
blocks.zh: 表9:按类别与选定的市场变量有显著关联的账户。

blocks.en: Disaggregation reproduces the aggregate picture on the return and reverses it on volatility. Eleven of the 67 Economy and Finance accounts (16.4%) correlate significantly with the daily return on both indices, against one of 70 in Politics and Government and three of 64 in Media and Society. The first figure is well above chance and the second well below it. The signs of those eleven are split six positive to five negative. So the category result is a matter of individual accounts relating to the index rather than of the category moving with it in a common direction.
blocks.zh: 分解复制了返回时的总图,并在波动性上倒置. 67个经济和金融账户中有11个(16.4%)与这两个指数的每日回报率密切相关,而政治和政府70个账户中有1个,媒体和社会64个账户中有3个。 第一个数字远高于机会,第二个数字远低于机会。 这11种迹象分为6正5负。 因此,类别结果是一个与指数相关的个别账户问题,而不是随指数向共同方向移动的类别问题。

blocks.en: On volatility the ordering reverses. Seventeen Politics and Government accounts (24.3%) correlate significantly with the official 21-day volatility series, twelve of them positively. It is the largest share of any category and more than twice the 11.9% recorded by Economy and Finance. BIST30 gives 21.4% and 11.9%. The largest single account-level correlation with the daily return found anywhere in the analysis ( | r | = 0.305 |r|=0.305 ) also belongs to a Politics and Government account, although on the trading-day coverage available to that account it stops just short of significance ( p = 0.0625 p=0.0625 ).
blocks.zh: 在波动时,订单倒置。 17个政治和政府账户(24.3%)与正式的21天波动系列密切相关,其中12个是积极的。 它是任何类别中最大的份额,是经济和金融记录的11.9%的两倍以上。 BIST30给出21.4%和11.9%. 与分析中发现的每日回报(  r = 0.305 | 0.305 )最大的单一账户级关联性也属于政治和政府账户,不过,在账户可用的交易日覆盖范围上,它只是没有意义(p = 0.0625 p = 0.0625 ).

blocks.en: Individual political accounts do relate to Borsa Istanbul, and more often than the accounts of the other two categories. What the category series loses, it loses in the aggregation. A few dominant accounts drowning out the rest would be the obvious explanation. But Politics and Government is the least concentrated of the three categories, its top decile of accounts holding 28.9% of the category’s posts against 44.0% in Economy and Finance and 54.8% in Media and Society. Institutional register runs evenly through the whole account list, so averaging over it removes the variation that the individual accounts carry.
blocks.zh: 个人政治账户确实与博尔萨·伊斯坦布尔有关,而且比其他两类账户更为频繁。 分类系列损失的,在汇总中损失. 将其余部分淹没的几个主要说法是显而易见的解释。 但政治和政府是这三类人中最不集中的,它拥有28.9%的账户,而经济和金融占44.0%,媒体和社会占54.8%。 机构登记册贯穿整个账户清单,因此平均数字消除了各账户带来的差异。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 What each domain measures
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 每个领域的措施

blocks.en: The results support H2 in a specific form. The three domains do not differ in the strength of a common relationship. They differ in which property of the market they attach to. Media and Society mood, and the Combined series that inherits its properties, relates to the magnitude of daily price movement. Economy and Finance mood relates to almost nothing contemporaneously and carries the predictive precedence, at lags of three days and longer. Politics and Government mood, in aggregate, relates to little at the category level beyond the volatility series, while its individual members relate to volatility more often than those of any other category.
blocks.zh: 结果以特定形式支持H2. 这三个领域在共同关系的强度上并无不同. 它们对其所附带的市场财产有所不同。 媒体和社会情绪,以及继承其属性的组合系列,都与日价格变动的规模有关. 经济和财政情绪几乎与同时期无关,具有预测性的优先地位,滞后三天甚至更长。 总体而言,政治和政府情绪在职类一级与波动系列无关,而其个别成员与波动性的关系比其他类别成员更为频繁。

blocks.en: This ordering follows from the composition of the account sets. Media and Society is the group least constrained by office and broadest in subject matter. As such its aggregate tone comes closest to a general public mood. Its full-period mean of − - 0.002 is the behaviour of a series responding to events in both directions. Economy and Finance sits nearest the flow of financial and policy information, its mean of − - 0.093 remains negative in all four sub-periods. So accounts covering the Turkish economy described it in negative terms across two years in which the index quadrupled. Politics and Government is constrained by office to communicate positively, with a mean of 0.510 and no negative day in 500. Three different quantities are being measured under one label, and the domain-specific design is what makes them separable.
blocks.zh: 这一顺序来自各账户的构成。 媒体和社会是受职务限制最少的群体,在主题方面最广泛。 因此,它的总调最接近于公众的情绪。 它的全周期平均值为− - 0.002,是一系列应对双向事件的行为. 经济和金融是财政和政策信息流动的最近地点,在所有四个分期内,其--0.093的平均值仍然是负数。 因此,覆盖土耳其经济的账户在指数翻了两番的两年里以负值描述土耳其经济。 政治和政府受到职务限制,无法积极沟通,平均为0.510,500年没有负日. 在一个标签下测得三个不同的量,而特定域的设计使得它们可以分离.

blocks.en: 6.2 Magnitude without direction
blocks.zh: 6.2 无方向宽度

blocks.en: Our most consistent result is also the one that constrains interpretation most tightly, and it is what H1 predicted in its semi-strong form. Publicly available tone carries no information about the direction of the next price change, only about how far the index travelled within the day. Two features point away from information pricing, towards attention. The relationship strengthens monotonically with aggregation while the return relationship does not. The daily null on returns is not a power problem. And the rank coefficients exceed the linear ones throughout, so extreme days matter more than a linear measure suggests. This is consistent with the attention and gradual-diffusion arguments in Section 2 , salient content is more likely to enter the decisions of investors who cannot process all available signals ( Barber and Odean, 2008 ) , and information reaching investors at different speeds produces effects that accumulate over horizons rather than appearing at once ( Hong and Stein, 1999 ) . Under that reading, a wide-range day and elevated public discussion are both expressions of a day on which something happened.
blocks.zh: 我们最一致的结果也是最严格地限制解释的结果,这也是H1以半强力形式预测的结果. 公开使用的语气没有关于下一次价格变化方向的信息,只是关于指数在白天走多远的信息. 有两个特征表明,信息定价与关注无关。 这种关系单调地与聚合相强化,而回归关系则没有. 返回的每日无效不是一个权力问题。 而排名系数在整个过程中都超过了线性系数,因此极端日比线性度量更重要. 这符合第2节的注意和逐渐分散的论点,突出的内容更可能进入无法处理所有可用信号的投资者的决定(Barber和Odean,2008年),以不同速度向投资者提供的信息会产生超越视野而不是同时出现的效果(Hong和Stein,1999年)。 根据这种解读,一个广泛的日子里和更高的公众讨论,都体现了发生事情的一天。

blocks.en: 6.3 The direction and horizon of transmission
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 传播的方向和前景

blocks.en: Both directions appear, and the lag structure separating them is the strongest internal evidence against a simple sentiment-transmission story. Three to five trading days is a long interval for a mood to travel but a comfortable one for information to diffuse outward from an announcement through a market in which a growing share of participants were new. That direction is not fixed, this was already visible in the Turkish evidence. Ateş and Güran (2021) found returns preceding sentiment over their long sample and sentiment preceding returns only inside a politically eventful window.
blocks.zh: 两个方向都出现了,而将它们分开的滞后结构是对一个简单的情绪传递故事最强烈的内部证据. 3至5个交易日是旅行气氛的长时期,但信息从公告向外传播,通过一个参与者比例不断增长的市场传播是舒适的。 这一方向没有固定,这在土耳其的证据中已经可见。 Ateş和Güran(2021年)发现,在返回之前,他们对于长期抽样的情绪和返回之前的情绪只是在政治事件窗口内。

blocks.en: The Economy and Finance predictive results are the strongest in the study and also the most exposed. That category contains the Central Bank, the Capital Markets Board, Borsa Istanbul and the economic ministries, so a large share of its posts are announcements rather than opinions. When a rate decision, an inflation print, a disclosure or a regulatory measure enters the mood score as a positively or negatively toned post on the day it appears, the market reprices over the following days. Granger test can separate that sequence from mood carrying information. This is not a hypothetical omitted variable but a documented property of the account list, and it is why we report the finding as predictive precedence rather than as an effect.
blocks.zh: 经济与金融预测结果在研究中是最强的,也是最暴露的。 这一类别包括中央银行、资本市场理事会、博尔萨·伊斯坦布尔和经济部,因此,其大部分职位是公告而不是意见。 当利率决定、通货膨胀印刷品、披露或监管措施在出现当日作为正面或负面的标注进入情绪评分时,市场在随后几天内重新定价。 Granger测试可以将这个序列与带情绪信息区分开来. 这不是一个假设的省略变量,而是账户清单的有文件记载的财产,正因为如此,我们才将调查结果报告为预测性优先,而不是一种效果。

blocks.en: One feature cuts the other way. The Economy and Finance labels come from the model with the largest seed-to-seed variance of the four. Classification noise attenuates a relationship rather than manufacturing one, so a noisier series producing a stronger result is weaker evidence in favor of the relationship. The finding rests nonetheless on the least stable measurement in the study.
blocks.zh: 一个特征 切换方式。 "经济金融"的标签来源于该型号,其种子对种子差异最大,位居四强. 分类噪声会削弱一种关系,而不是制造一种关系,因此产生更强烈结果的噪声系列是有利于关系的较弱证据. 然而,研究结果取决于研究中最不稳定的衡量标准。

blocks.en: 6.4 State dependence
blocks.zh: 6.4 国家依赖性

blocks.en: H5 is the hypothesis the data support most strongly. It is supported on both indices simultaneously and under all four regimes. The pattern is what the Adaptive Markets Hypothesis anticipates ( Lo, 2004 ) , a relationship observed under one set of conditions need not persist when the composition of participants, the credibility of public messages and the decision rules in use change together. It is also what the political-uncertainty literature would predict. When the resolution of political uncertainty is itself the dominant national news, commentary that follows prices rather than preceding them is close to what should be expected ( Pastor and Veronesi, 2013 ) . The corpus registers the same shift internally. Politics and Government mood rises from 0.482 in 2022 to 0.637 in the election quarter, the largest sub-period movement of any regime, while Economy and Finance falls to − - 0.121. The divergence between political messaging and economic commentary peaks where the macroeconomic record would put it.
blocks.zh: H5是数据支持最强的假设. 它在两个指数上和在所有四个制度下同时得到支持。 其模式是适应性市场假设(Lo,2004年)所预期的,当参与者的组成、公共信息的可信度以及使用中的决定规则一起变化时,在一套条件下观察到的关系就不需要继续下去。 这也正是政治不确定文献所预测的。 当政治不确定性的解决本身成为全国主流新闻时, 人身保护官在内部登记了同样的转变。 政治和政府情绪从2022年的0.482上升到选举季度的0.637,这是任何政权最大的次时期运动,而经济和财政则下降到−-0.121。 政治信息与经济评论之间的差异是宏观经济记录所显示的顶峰。

blocks.en: The earthquake quarter requires separate comment because it produces the least of the four sub-periods, the opposite of what the crisis-sentiment literature would predict. Three explanations are available and they are not seperate. Trading was suspended for part of the quarter, and the missing days immediately after 6 February are precisely where a leading relationship would have to appear. The posts of these accounts during a humanitarian catastrophe are about the catastrophe, so for several weeks the series may not be measuring economic mood at all. And 61 observations is a thin basis for a lag-five test. The first two explanations are the more consequential, because both imply that the measure stops capturing the same construct during exactly the events where it is expected to matter most.
blocks.zh: 地震季度需要单独评论,因为它产生四个分周期中最少的,与危机感应文献预测的相反. 现有三种解释,它们不是孤立的。 2月6日之后的失踪日正是主要关系必须出现的地方。 在人道主义灾难期间,这些账户的帖子是有关灾难的,因此,几周来,这些系列可能根本无法衡量经济情绪。 而61个观测数据是落后5个测试的稀疏基础. 前两个解释是比较间接的,因为两者都意味着,在预期最重要的事件期间,措施停止捕捉同样的构造。

blocks.en: 6.5 Aggregation as a measurement problem
blocks.zh: 6.5 汇总作为一个衡量问题

blocks.en: The comparison across labelling regimes yields a result that generalises beyond this dataset. A sentiment score computed over all posts in a day does not represent the corpus. It represents whichever category posted most. The Politics and Government series shows the same issue more starkly, averaging 70 accounts constrained by office to communicate positively produces a series whose sign never changes in 500 trading days. So whatever valence its members express individually is compressed into a narrow positive band around a mean of 0.510. The account-level results in Table 9 confirm that this is a property of the method rather than of the accounts. The individual members of that category relate to volatility more often than those of any other.
blocks.zh: 标签制度之间的比较产生的结果超出了这一数据集的范围。 一天内所有职位的情绪得分不能代表犯罪事实。 它代表张贴最多的类别。 " 政治和政府 " 系列更突出地显示了同样的问题,平均有70个账户受到办公室的限制,无法进行积极的交流,这一系列的标志在500个交易日中从未改变。 所以,无论其成员个人表达什么荣耀,都会被压缩成一个狭义的正带,大约是0.510的平均值. 表9中的账户一级结果证实,这是方法而不是账户的财产。 该类别的个别成员比任何其他成员更经常地涉及波动。

blocks.en: The weakness of the aggregate Politics and Government results is therefore a limitation of the aggregation and not evidence that political speech is unrelated to Borsa Istanbul. The artefact is available to any study that scores an institutionally constrained account set daily and then averages, nothing in the output of a daily mean announces its presence.
blocks.zh: 因此,总体政治和政府成果的弱点是对汇总的限制,而不是政治言论与博尔萨·伊斯坦布尔无关的证据。 任何研究如果每天对机构限制的账户进行评分,然后是平均值,则日均产出中没有任何内容宣布存在。

blocks.en: 6.6 Alternative explanations
blocks.zh: 6.6 其他解释

blocks.en: For attributing market movements to a single driver, Turkiye’s January 2022-December 2023 period is unsuitable: it combines recurring lira depreciation, inflation above 80%, a policy-rate cut to 8.5% followed by post-May 2023 tightening, the February 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes, and an IPO surge that altered the investor base.
blocks.zh: Turkiye 2022年1月至2023年12月的市场波动与单一驱动力不相称:它结合了反复发生的里拉贬值、超过80%的通胀率、政策率削减至8.5%,随后是2023年5月之后的紧缩、2023年2月的Kahramanmaraş 地震以及改变投资者基础的IPO激增。

blocks.en: Each has a documented impact on the index. Changepoint analysis of Turkish equity volatility relates shifts to central bank decisions, domestic political incidents and global shocks ( Altinbas, 2025 ) . Over a longer sample, inflation and inflation uncertainty are both found to raise BIST100 returns, consistent with Turkish equities being held as an inflation hedge ( Esen et al., 2025 ) . Elections are known to produce unusual returns on Borsa Istanbul accumulating from roughly a month before the vote to two weeks after it, with volatility running one and a half to two times its pre-election average ( Kayaçetin, 2023 ) . An event study of the 2023 election in particular reports strongly positive cumulative abnormal returns around the second round ( Bash and Al-Awadhi, 2023 ) . For the earthquake, a Bayesian structural time series analysis using global indices as controls estimates a substantial negative effect on the BIST100 against its counterfactual ( Khan et al., 2024 ) . Mechanisms unrelated to any account’s posts explain the level path of the index, which is the light in which the non-stationary coefficients of Section 5 should be read.
blocks.zh: 每个指数对指数都有文件记载的影响。 土耳其股票波动变化点分析涉及中央银行决定、国内政治事件和全球冲击的转变(Altinbas,2025年)。 在更长的样本中,通货膨胀和通货膨胀的不确定性都提高了BIST100的收益,这与土耳其股票作为通货膨胀套期保值持有一致(Esen等人,2025年)。 据了解,选举在博尔萨伊斯坦布尔产生不同寻常的回报,从投票前大约一个月累积到投票后两周,波动是选举前平均数(Kayaçetin,2023年)的1.5至2倍。 对2023年大选的一项事件研究特别报道了第二轮选举前后的强烈的累积反常回报(Bash and Al-Awadhi, 2023). 对于本次地震,巴耶西亚结构时间序列分析使用全球指数作为控制值,估计对BIST100与其反事实有很大的负面影响(Khan等人,2024年)。 与任何账户员额无关的机制解释指数的水平路径,即第5节非固定系数应读取的光线。

blocks.en: Three confounds affect the significant results. The magnitude relationship may reflect common causes: major events move markets and prompt related posting, which correlation cannot disentangle. The Economy and Finance predictive results may reflect the announcement channel, while the election-quarter reversal coincides with the election, a policy transition, and the start of rate hikes within only 59 trading days. Finally, the polarity-based measure omits posting volume, which other markets suggest can strongly predict volatility ( Hamraoui and Boubaker, 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 三个问题影响到重大成果。 规模关系可能反映共同的原因:重大事件会移动市场,并迅速发布相关信息,而相关信息无法分散。 经济和财政预测结果可能反映宣布的渠道,而选举季度的逆转恰逢选举,政策转型,而利率的起步仅仅在59个交易日之内. 最后,基于极性的计量省略了公布的数量,而其他市场则认为这可以有力地预测波动性(Hamraoui和Boubaker,2022年)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We examined whether the tone of communication by influential Turkish public accounts has a measurable relationship with Borsa Istanbul. We analysed 610,422 posts published by 176 curated accounts between January 2022 and December 2023, labelled them with four fine-tuned Turkish transformer models under three domain-specific regimes and one pooled regime, then tested the resulting series against the BIST100 and BIST30 over 500 trading days.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了有影响力的土耳其公共账户的通信基调是否与博尔萨·伊斯坦布尔有着可衡量的关系。 我们分析了2022年1月至2023年12月期间由176个主管账户公布的610 422个员额,将其贴上四个经过微调的土耳其变压器模型,置于三个特定域的制度和一个集合制度之下,然后在500个交易日对BIST100和BIST30进行测试。

blocks.en: Five findings hold. Public mood is not associated with the direction of returns under any regime, on either index or at any frequency. It is associated instead with the magnitude of daily price movement, and that association strengthens with aggregation in a manner consistent with attention and gradual diffusion rather than with the pricing of new information. Predictive precedence runs in both directions and is concentrated by domain, mood-to-market at three and five days and market-to-mood at one. The relationship reverses in sign and direction during the 2023 election quarter under all four regimes and on both indices. And the four labelling regimes do not agree, and the pooled series reproduce whichever category contributes the most posts.
blocks.zh: 5项调查结果仍然有效。 公共情绪与任何制度下的回返方向无关,无论是指数还是频率。 相反,这种联系与每日价格变动的规模有关,这种联系以与注意力和逐步传播一致的方式,而不是与新信息的定价一致的方式,通过汇总而加强。 预测优先线双向运行,按域位集中,情绪对市场3~5天,市场对市场1天. 在2023年选举季度期间,在所有四个制度和两个指数下,这种关系在标志和方向上发生逆转。 四个标签制度并不一致,集合系列复制了哪些类别贡献最多的员额。

blocks.en: 7.1 Implications
blocks.zh: 7.1 影响

blocks.en: For regulators and exchange operators, the state dependence result is most relevant. Domain-specific mood indicators appear more useful for identifying episodes when public discourse and market activity become tightly coupled than for predicting market direction. Here, coupling was strongest around a national election, and the market-to-mood direction dominated. This suggests that online commentary in such episodes may reflect price and volatility rather than independently drive instability.
blocks.zh: 对监管者和交易所经营者来说,国家依赖性结果最为相关。 与预测市场方向相比,特定领域情绪指标似乎更有助于确定公共言论和市场活动紧密结合的情况。 在此,全国大选的结合最为有力,市场对市场的方向占主导地位。 这表明,此类事件中的在线评论可能反映价格和波动,而不是独立推动不稳定。

blocks.en: For market participants, the absence of an association with returns applies only to this corpus and construction. Speaker-based sampling and daily averaging discard financial-content selection, posting volume, and within-day timing. The results therefore do not rule out discourse-return relationships; rather, observed associations concern movement magnitude rather than direction, with signs varying across the two-year window.
blocks.zh: 对于市场参与者来说,没有与收益挂钩只适用于这种资产和结构。 以演讲者为主的抽样和每天平均丢弃的财务内容选择、张贴量和日内时间安排。 因此,结果并不排除言论-回归关系;相反,观察到的协会所关注的是运动规模,而不是方向,在两年的窗口中,迹象各不相同。

blocks.en: For researchers, the aggregation result is most transferable. Pooling heterogeneous speaker groups can produce a series whose variance and findings are dominated by the largest group. Category-level and account-level analyses should therefore precede interpretation of pooled measures.
blocks.zh: 对于研究人员来说,汇总结果最可转移。 汇集各式各样的演讲者小组可以产生一个系列,其差异和调查结果以最大的小组为主。 因此,在解释集合措施之前,应先进行类别和账户一级的分析。

blocks.en: 7.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7.2 限制

blocks.en: Five limitations bound our results. We measure public mood rather than investor sentiment, and the one-million-follower threshold ensures reach but not investor relevance. The two-year window includes major shocks—a currency crisis, inflation above 80%, a monetary-regime change, a catastrophic earthquake, and a national election—and the results show that relationships were not stable within it, limiting extrapolation. Sub-periods contain only 59-128 trading days, adequate for correlations but limited for five-lag Granger tests; stationarity classifications also differ across periods, making the specifications non-identical. The Economy and Finance model is the weakest and least stable across seeds, yet underlies the strongest predictive result. We conduct many tests without formal multiple-comparison correction, so isolated significant findings warrant caution. Our main robustness criterion is replication across regimes, indices, and frequencies.
blocks.zh: 五种限制束缚了我们的成果。 我们衡量的是公众的情绪,而不是投资者的情绪,100万追随者的门槛确保了达到但与投资者无关的程度。 这一两年的窗口包括重大冲击 — — 货币危机、超过80%的通货膨胀、货币制度的变化、灾难性的地震、以及全国大选 — — 其结果表明,内部关系不稳定,限制了推断。 分周期只包含59-128个交易日,适合相关情况,但限作五层格朗格测试;不同时期的站点性分类也不同,使得规格不同. 经济和金融模式是种子中最弱和最不稳定的模式,但却是预测结果最强的基础。 我们进行了许多测试,但没有正式的多比校正,因此孤立的重要结论值得谨慎。 我们的主要强性标准是跨制度、指数和频率的复制。

blocks.en: 7.3 Further research
blocks.zh: 7.3 进一步研究

blocks.en: Three extensions follow. Adding posting volume alongside polarity would separate salience from tone and test whether volume better predicts market magnitude. Time-varying or recursive-window causality over a longer sample could assess whether the election-quarter market-to-mood coupling recurs in similar episodes. Finally, replication on Turkish investor forums or the same accounts during a calmer period would help establish which findings are robust beyond this dataset.
blocks.zh: 续续三部. 将投放量与极性相提并论,将使声调与声调区分开来,并检验量是否更好地预测市场规模。 在较长的抽样中,时间变化或递归式窗口的因果关系可以评估选举季度市场与混合组合在类似情况下是否再次发生。 最后,在较平静的时期复制土耳其投资者论坛或同一账户将有助于确定哪些结论超出这一数据集。
